W23 isolates request audit SQLite from activity store to avoid single-flight collision; record limitation. NativeHealth.checkOnce uses real enumerate/current/recover and pending journals. The positive uses 1-second timeout and 1.25-second actual wait. Threshold and reverse-clock controls project only ServerNowUtc after genuine Hub reads, never call projected values live host time. Compose actual ChallengeWorkflow.create/get, blockAttempt, resolve, wakeDependents, requeueAttempt and LedgerStore.fetch on same disposable project binding. W23 ChallengeBlockedAttemptWakesViaCanonicalReverseIndex demonstrates real issued index, Waiting/Blocked, cross-clone resolve to Requeued wait, Queued generation 2 and Ready owner, exact-op replay and stale denial. Manual zero-dependency requeue is separate. W17 wake registration is accepted source; prove composed receipt delivery rather than inventing trigger evidence.

Fixed scenario: (1) create stable task/attempt/owner, source lease, generation N; real qualifying activity; two fresh checks -> no recovery and unchanged ledger. After actual 1s stall synchronize clients; fresh Git read shows one RecoverAgentAssignment original receipt and exactly N+1, same task/attempt/owner/spec/source; counters may include idempotent replay and are not CAS counts. (2) Block that exact attempt on unresolved condition, read Waiting record/reverse index/versions and Blocked from both clones; resolve with exact actor/version/op; assert canonical receipt/history, one Requeued wait, Queued attempt and Ready owner, exact new assignment generation, same-op replay unchanged and stale/different op denial. Record actual generation, do not assume 2 after recovery. (3) only after accepted real scheduler interfaces converge, use existing authenticated account/project bindings, complete verified roster/coverage and per-kind/project capacity. Derive candidate from exact Started assignment or verified reviewer claim; preserve reservation, dispatch, effect and claim IDs and source lease. Race contenders: exactly one canonical project pre-send fence CAS; loser and uncertain ACK retain account occupancy. Read both ledgers and original receipts. (4) in separate cases prove original-bound project exclusion and no-send release from origin/current tombstone/evidence/intent, and genuine authenticated provider-session terminal with matching original identity before terminal release. Missing issuer -> HOLD. Unknown/submitted/uncertain/active remain occupied; no replay or second send, duplicate capacity-one dispatch refused.

Negative controls: missing/unregistered/foreign activity; recent/future/reversed/reset clock; changed binding/source/generation, stale head, duplicate UUID with changed bytes; wrong wait/index/owner/condition or failed resolution; incomplete roster/membership/role, zero/revoked capacity, altered account/project epoch/head/claim generation; forged/missing/replaced no-send tombstone or intent; foreign/late/duplicate terminal, unknown and lost ACK. Assert unchanged appropriate ledger heads/receipts/occupancy or exact expected rejection. Missing data, closed tab or timeout is not terminal/no-send.
